mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO hyperlink_task_round_account (hyperlink_task_id, hyperlink_task_round_id, round_no, task_account_usage_id, account_id, selection_no, assignment_status, selected_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{hyperlinkTaskId}, #{hyperlinkTaskRoundId}, #{roundNo}, #{taskAccountUsageId}, #{accountId}, #{selectionNo}, #{assignmentStatus}, #{selectedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hyperlink_task_round_account WHERE hyperlink_task_round_id=#{roundId} ORDER BY selection_no, id
mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM hyperlink_task_round_account a INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_round r ON r.id=a.hyperlink_task_round_id AND r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.hyperlink_task_id=#{taskId} AND r.round_status=8 AND r.send_total=0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_round_account WHERE hyperlink_task_round_id=#{roundId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_round_account a INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage u ON u.id=a.task_account_usage_id WHERE a.hyperlink_task_round_id=#{roundId} AND a.assignment_status=1 AND u.usage_status=1 AND (u.success_limit=0 OR u.successful_send_count+u.reserved_success_slot_count<u.success_limit)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hyperlink_task_round_account a INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage u ON u.id=a.task_account_usage_id WHERE a.hyperlink_task_round_id=#{roundId} AND u.usage_status=6
mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_round_account a INNER JOIN hyperlink_task_account_usage u ON u.id=a.task_account_usage_id AND u.tenant_id=a.tenant_id SET a.assignment_status=CASE WHEN u.usage_status=2 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, a.released_at=COALESCE(a.released_at,#{now}), a.updated_at=#{now} WHERE a.hyperlink_task_round_id=#{roundId} AND a.assignment_status=1 AND u.usage_status IN (2,3,4,5,6)
